create_FMMPlanner: create an FMMPlanner instance with a traversability map and step size for robot navigation
set_goal_single: set a single goal coordinate on the traversability map and compute fast marching method distances
set_goal_multi: set multiple goal regions from a binary goal map for object goal navigation tasks
get_short_term_goal: get the next short-term goal coordinate for the robot based on current state and FMM distances
visualize_fmm_distances: visualize the traversability map, goal map, and FMM distance field as a saved image
